description: Channels the daily pipeline PREPARES AND RENDERS (owner, 2026-10-30: ten channels; the three with working upload credentials publish, the rest run to the end and stop before upload). config/priority-channels.json stays the list of channels that may UPLOAD; add a channel there once its OAuth secrets exist. Every id here must resolve through scripts/lib/channel-lookup.cjs and have an editor_look (1-5) in config/channels.json.
